column6: Observing natural patterns aligns with cosmic consciousness and Vastu's Ishan corner.
Harness and store solar and pranic energy (Agni) in soil, water, and biomass.
Ensure actions produce tangible yields, reflecting the fulfillment (bhoga) of life.
Recycle and compost organic matter, returning offerings to the Earth and Varuna's domain.
Use mandala patterns and sacred geometry (tantra) to guide design from macrocosm to microcosm.
Foster integration and harmony among guild elements, akin to Yoga and Vayu's relational nature.
Honor diversity of species and elements, reflecting the harmony of the five elements.
Embrace patience and incremental growth, aligned with Saturn's discipline and Varuna's steadiness.
